grace_seconds.description: How long the previous secret keeps signing, in seconds: from 300 (5 minutes) to 604800 (7 days). Ignored when there is no previous secret.

force.description: End the grace period of an older secret that still signs. Without it, a rotation during that grace period returns `409 webhook_secret_in_grace`.

200.description: The new secret. It is shown only in this response.

secret.description: The signing secret: `whsec_` followed by base64.

created_at.description: Unix time (seconds) when the secret was created.

previous_retires_at.description: Unix time (seconds) when the previous secret stops signing, or `null` if there was none.

400.description: `grace_seconds` is out of range, or the body has an unknown field.

403.description: `webhook_secret_owner_only`: only an organization owner or a workspace admin can create or rotate the secret, from the dashboard or with a management API key.

409.description: `webhook_secret_in_grace`: an older secret is still in its grace period. The body carries `previous_retires_at`. Nothing changed.

Actor.description: Who created the secret, or `null` for a secret created before this was recorded.

kind.description: Created from the dashboard or with a management API key.

api_key_id.description: The management API key used, if any.
